insightTech: AI music landscape shifting: Suno/Udio settled lawsuits, now paying licensing fees. ElevenLabs entered the race. Major labels launching licensed AI platforms. Stock music market being commoditized by AI generators. New VSTs (Serum 2, MOSAIQ) still relevant alongside AI tools. Google and Apple now embedding AI music in core apps. Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as CCO.
insightStrategy: Musio+ Complete differentiates through bundling real instruments from multiple developers - AI can't replicate authentic human performance. Need visibility push before launch - Musio not appearing in current AI music discussions. Consider press outreach. UNESCO reports 24% income decline threat for music creators.

research.title: AMD forges $100 billion deal with Meta for AI chips
research.summary: Meta signed a multi-year agreement to buy six gigawatts worth of AMD processors for AI data centers. The deal could see Meta owning 10 percent of AMD's stock.

research.title: OpenAI's Stargate struggles
research.summary: OpenAI reportedly explored building its own data centers as the three companies disagreed over their roles, but high costs have led the AI giant to strike individual deals with SoftBank and Oracle instead.

research.title: X working on 'Made with AI' labels
research.summary: The in-development feature shows a toggle allowing users to disclose synthetically made or manipulated content, in response to India ordering social platforms to embrace provenance systems like C2PA.

research.title: ChatGPT ads now live
research.summary: Ads from Expedia, Qualcomm, Best Buy, and Enterprise Mobility are starting to show up in ChatGPT responses.

research.title: Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as Chief Commercial Officer
research.summary: Suno, the AI music generation startup, has hired former Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as CCO to lead commercial strategy. Sirota will report directly to CEO Mikey Shulman.

research.title: Google launches Lyria 3 - most advanced AI music generator - in Gemini app
research.summary: Google's Lyria 3 model is now available in the Gemini app, letting users create 30-second tracks from text prompts or images. This is Google's most advanced AI music generation yet.

research.title: AI sample generator Just 4 Noise raises $1M
research.summary: Just 4 Noise, an AI sample generator that lets producers describe sounds they want and get unique royalty-free samples for their DAW, raised $1M from BADideas.fund and Sound Hub Denmark.

research.title: Apple revives Apple Music Connect as B2B promo platform
research.summary: Apple has relaunched Apple Music Connect as a B2B platform for labels and distributors, giving teams a single dashboard to manage release cycle elements.

research.title: Sony Group develops tech to track original music in AI-generated songs
research.summary: Sony Group has developed technology to identify and track original music within AI-generated songs, addressing copyright concerns in the AI music space.

research.title: AI-driven kids media firm Animaj strikes global deal with The Orchard and Sony Music Publishing
research.summary: Animaj's global deal sees The Orchard's kids division handle recordings distribution while Sony Music Publishing administers publishing rights across their catalogue.

research.title: Live Nation revenues top $25B in 2025
research.summary: Live Nation reported revenues exceeding $25B in 2025, up $2B year-over-year, with adjusted operating operating profit of $2.4B.

research.title: Artists face steep income decline due to AI, UNESCO finds
research.summary: Music creators could see their revenues fall by 24 per cent, while those working in the audiovisual sector may lose 21 per cent of their income.

research.title: Google and Apple bring AI music creation to mainstream consumers
research.summary: Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Apple Inc. are adding music-focused generative artificial intelligence features to their core consumer apps.

research.title: The rise of AI music could be a good thing for record-label and streaming stocks
research.summary: Analysis of how AI music may impact music industry stocks and investment strategies.

research.title: Top AI Music Companies 2026
research.summary: Udio and Suno both sued by major labels in 2024, now settling. Udio reached settlement with Universal in Oct 2025. New licensed AI platforms launching in 2026.

research.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Music
research.summary: ElevenLabs launches ElevenLabs Music, entering AI music race alongside Suno and Udio with artist-led releases.

research.title: Universal Music + NVIDIA Partnership
research.summary: Universal Music Group partnered with NVIDIA to develop AI music discovery and creation tools, pledging 'Antidote' to 'AI Slop'.

research.title: Google Gemini Launches Lyria 3
research.summary: Google's Lyria 3 is now available in the Gemini app, allowing users to create 30-second tracks from text prompts or images.

research.title: Taylor Swift Trademarks, J. Cole Cam'ron Response, AI Songs Debate
research.summary: Legal news covering Taylor Swift trademarks, J. Cole's response to Cam'ron lawsuit, and ongoing AI songs debate.

research.title: Xania Monet's Manager Launches Label JV With Create
research.summary: New label joint venture supporting both 'AI-Driven' and 'Traditional' talent, showing industry embrace of AI in artist development.

research.title: AI Opt-In Isn't Enough - Artists Want Partnership
research.summary: Guest column argues that AI opt-in is the floor, not the ceiling - artists want respect and partnership, not just licenses.

research.title: AI Platform KLAY Signs Licensing Deals With UMG, WMG, Sony
research.summary: KLAY signed licensing deals with Universal, Warner, and Sony for both recorded music and publishing rights, becoming one of the first fully licensed AI music platforms.

research.title: Suno & WMG Ink Licensing Deal, Settling Lawsuit
research.summary: Suno and Warner Music Group signed a licensing deal, effectively settling WMG's legal claims against the AI music company.

research.title: iHeartRadio Won't Play AI Music or Use AI Generated Personalities
research.summary: iHeartMedia executive says company won't play AI music or use AI generated personalities in podcasts or radio, in a staff memo outlining new programming direction.
